personalInfo.name: Prince Jain
personalInfo.tagline: I build APIs and backend systems that don't fall over at 3am.
personalInfo.bio: I'm a backend developer with 2.5 years of experience building systems for the insurance and BFSI space. My work sits at the intersection of secure API design and messy real-world data — from integrating insurance provider APIs for real-time quote generation, to building multi-tenant platforms with role-based access for admins, corporates, and POS users. I care about backend systems that stay fast and predictable under load, not just ones that work in a demo. Currently based in Mumbai, and always looking to sharpen how I think about database performance and system design.

principles.title: Design the contract first
principles.body: I settle the API shape, error semantics, and pagination model before writing handlers. A clear contract keeps the frontend unblocked and makes the implementation a detail rather than a negotiation.

principles.title: Assume the data is messy
principles.body: Real insurance data arrives inconsistent, partial, and duplicated. I build ingestion and integration code that validates at the boundary, fails loudly on bad input, and never silently corrupts the store.

principles.title: Multi-tenancy and access are not afterthoughts
principles.body: Tenant isolation and role-based access get modelled into the schema and the query layer from day one — Admin, Corporate, Manager, and POS users should be structurally unable to see each other's data.

principles.title: Optimise where the traffic actually is
principles.body: I profile before I tune. The wins come from indexing the real hot paths, removing N+1s, and scoping queries — not from micro-optimising code that runs once a day.

projects.name: Insurance Policy Management Platform
projects.description: Backend services powering corporate & retail insurance journeys — from quote comparison to policy issuance, admin operations, and POS onboarding.
projects.contribution: Built a multi-tenant architecture with tenant-specific configs, RBAC-secured APIs, and integrations with multiple insurer APIs for quote comparison and policy sync.
highlights: Multi-tenant data model with per-tenant configuration and structural isolation between tenants
RBAC enforced at the query layer across Admin, Corporate, Manager, and POS roles
Normalised 5+ third-party insurer APIs behind a single internal quote/issuance contract
Idempotent policy-sync jobs so retries never double-issue or corrupt state

projects.name: Bulk Insurance Data Migration Utility
projects.description: A Node.js tool built to migrate large-scale legacy insurance data into a structured MySQL database.
projects.contribution: Designed a streaming ingestion pipeline that validates, transforms, and batch-inserts legacy records with full reporting on rejects.
highlights: Streams large Excel workbooks instead of loading them into memory
Validates and transforms each row at the boundary, quarantining bad records with reasons
Batched, transactional inserts so a mid-run failure leaves the target in a known state

projects.name: POS Onboarding & Reporting Module
projects.description: Onboarding workflow for POS partners including KYC verification, certification tracking, and dynamic reporting.
projects.contribution: Built reporting APIs with filtering/pagination and dynamic PDF/Excel exports, following VAPT-aligned security practices.
highlights: State-machine-driven onboarding covering KYC, certification, and activation stages
Reporting APIs with composable filters, server-side pagination, and stable sorting
On-demand PDF and Excel exports generated from the same query layer as the API

experience.summary: Backend developer on a multi-tenant insurance platform serving corporate, retail, and POS distribution channels.
bullets: Developed and maintained 20+ production-grade REST APIs powering insurance workflows — quotes, policy issuance, payments, claims, and endorsements.
Integrated 5+ insurance provider APIs for real-time quote generation and policy synchronization, normalising inconsistent third-party contracts behind one internal API.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and RBAC across Admin, Corporate, Manager, and POS user roles, enforced down to the query layer.
Cut bulk data migration time by ~90% by building a Node.js utility processing 100,000+ Excel records into MySQL in under 30 seconds.
Optimized high-traffic endpoints through indexing, query tuning, and Sequelize scopes, improving response times on the busiest routes.
